question: Can I Open An Account While Outside The Country?
answer: Yes. You can open an account online here while out of the country.

question: Is It Possible To Open An Account In The Country And Operate The Account While Out Of The Country?
answer: Yes. The account can be operated through any of our card products or internet banking solution.

question: Do I Need A Withdrawal Booklet To Operate A Savings Account?
answer: No. A withdrawal slip, located in all branches is all that is required to withdraw cash at any of the branches.

question: How Can I Open A Salary Account?
answer: Your company / organisation will write the bank to introduce the prospective account holder to the bank for account opening.

question: How Long Does It Take Before My Account Becomes Inactive?
answer: Current accounts become dormant after 6 months of inactivity.

question: Can A Savings Account Become Dormant?
answer: No. savings accounts do not go dormant.

question: How Long Does It Take To Open An Account With The Bank?
answer: Accounts are opened within 24 hours upon submission of complete documentation.

question: Do I Get Charged For Operating And Doing Transactions From Another Branch Other Than Where My Account Was Opened?
answer: No. There is no charge for operating your account from another branch.

question: Can I Initiate Transfers From My Naira Account To My Dollar Account Or Dollar To My Naira Account?
answer: No you cannot transfer funds from a Dollar to a Naira account and vice versa because both accounts are in different currencies. You can however convert funds in your dollar account to Naira and have this paid into your Naira account at the official exchange rate by visiting any Zenith Bank branch nationwide.

question: Can I Update My Account Details From Any Branch?
answer: Yes. Account update requests can be made at any of the branches.

question: Must I Visit My Branch To Request Any Product Or Service?
answer: No. requests can be made from any of the bank”s branches or through our Contact Centre (Zenith Direct).

question: What Is The Minimum Account Opening Amount?
answer: Accounts can be opened with any amount or with Zero balance as there is no minimum account opening amount requirement for all Zenith Bank Account classes with the exception of our Zenith Gold and Platinum Accounts that have a N1 million and N3 million requirement respectively.

question: How Long Does It Take For An Account To Be Transferred To Another Branch?
answer: About 24 hours after the request has been received and duly approved.

question: Will My Account Number Change If I Transfer My Account To Another Branch?
answer: No, The NUBAN account series is unique and same. The only change is the address of the new branch that will appear on your next cheque book.

question: Does A Savings Account Holder Get A Passbook To Run His/Her Account? If So, How?
answer: No. A savings account holder can withdraw from his account at any of our branches by completing a withdrawal slip.

question: Can the same individual have more than one account with different branches?
answer: It is possible, only if the customer has different classes of accounts. E.g. a customer can have a savings account with one branch and a current account with another branch but cannot have 2 savings accounts or 2 current accounts with 2 different branches or with the same branch.

question: How Does A Customer Request A Cheque Book?
answer: The customer will need to complete a cheque book requisition slip which can be gotten from any branch of Zenith Bank plc. Otherwise, the customer can write to the bank requesting a chequebook. In both cases, the request will need to be signed according to the mandate of the account. He can also apply via the Internet Banking platform or by self-service on the Zenith Direct platform.

question: How Long Does It Take For The Request To Be Processed?
answer: It takes 24 hours for Lagos branches and 48 ” 72 hours for up-country branches (branches outside Lagos).

question: How Many Leaves Are Contained In A Cheque Book And How Much Does It Cost?
answer: A cheque book for an individual account may contain 20 or 50 leaves, and for a corporate account 50 or 100 leaves. 20leaves cost ₦525, 50leaves cost ₦1050 and 100leaves cost ₦2100.

question: Can A Cheque Book Request Be Made In One Branch And The Cheque Book Collected From Another?
answer: Yes. The customer will need to indicate at the point of request where he would like to pick the cheque book up from and the cheque book will be delivered to that branch.

question: Can A Cheque Book Request Be Made Online?
answer: Yes. There is an option for online request for users on our internet banking platform or through Zenith Direct .

question: Can A Third Party Collect A Customer’s Cheque Book? If So, How?
answer: Yes, a third party can collect a cheque book on the account holder”s behalf. The account holder will need to write a letter authorizing the bearer to collect the cheque book on his behalf. The letter must be duly signed and the bearer must have a valid / acceptable means of identification.

question: How Does A Customer Activate A New Cheque Book Recently Collected?
answer: The customer will need to sign the cheque book acknowledgement slip. This slip is the first page in the cheque book. The signed slip is returned to the bank (through the Customer Services unit or the accounts officer) and the cheque book will be activated.

question: What Does A Customer Who Has Misplaced His Cheque Book Do?
answer: The customer should advise the bank immediately of the loss so that the cheque book will be blocked. To get another cheque book, copies of a sworn affidavit, police report and a completed indemnity form and a duly signed letter reporting the loss are required from the customer.

question: What Are The Requirements For A Change Of Address?
answer: A duly signed instruction from the account holder informing us of the change of address, as well as a current PUR which has the new address of the customer, are needed for a change of address.

question: How Long Will It Take For The Change Of Address To Be Effected?
answer: It will only take a few minutes, if all the requirements are in place.

question: Will The Name Change Take Effect Immediately?
answer: Yes. If all the requirements are in place, the name change will only take a few minutes.

question: What Are The Requirements For A Change Of Name For A Corporate Account?
answer: A new certificate of incorporation and a letter from the customer requesting a change.

question: Will This Change Be Effected Immediately?
answer: A search will be carried out on the new document and name will be changed if the search returns with matching information. edit button to change this text.

question: What Do I Need To Run/Open A Fixed Deposit Account With The Bank?
answer: If the customer has a current or savings account with the Bank, A duly signed letter of authority instructing the Bank to debit the proposed amount from the customer”s respective account will suffice. Such instruction from the customer will include specific details needed to book the fixed deposit such as customer”s account number, amount to be booked, tenor of deposit and the agreed rate.; If the customer is not an account holder in the bank, he will have to open a fixed deposit account. (Refer to account opening documentation).

question: What Is The Minimum And Maximum Tenor Obtainable?
answer: Minimum tenor on fixed deposit is 30 days, whilst the maximum is as determined by the Bank based on current money market realities.

question: How Is The Interest Accrued On A Deposit Calculated?
answer: The interest accrued is calculated on simple interest basis.

question: What Amount Is Deducted As Withholding Tax (WHT) And How Is It Calculated?
answer: WHT charge is 10%. It is calculated as 10% of total accrued interest earned in a particular period on the fixed amount.

question: How Can I Liquidate My Fixed/Call Deposit?
answer: A duly signed letter of authority instructing the Bank to liquidate the fixed/call deposit will suffice.

question: What Are Treasury Bills?
answer: Treasury bills are government guaranteed debt instruments issued by CBN on behalf of FGN to finance short-term expenditure.

question: What Are Treasury Bills Rates?
answer: There are no specific rates for Treasury Bills as purchase is done through a bid/auction system organized by the CBN or through the Two Way Quote Market.

question: What Tenors Are Available For Treasury Bills Investment?
answer: Treasury Bills could either be 91, 182 or 364-Days tenor.

question: What Is MPR?
answer: MPR means Monetary Policy Rate. It is a bench mark rate introduced in 2006 to replace the Minimum Rediscount Rate (MRR). It serves as an indicative rate in the inter-bank market.

question: What Is The Current Monetary Policy Rate (MPR)?
answer: MPR is currently 12% (However this is subject to change at the discretion of the Monetary Policy Committee).

question: What Is The Interbank Market?
answer: The Interbank market is a medium by which Banks avail themselves of short-term funds on a daily basis to meet their short-term liquidity needs. Trading is usually done between Banks and Discount Houses only and the market is open from 10.00hrs ” 14.00hrs.

question: What Does NIBOR Mean?
answer: NIBOR is the Nigeria Inter Bank Offered Rate and it is determined by the Financial Markets Dealers Association (FMDA) with reference to various selected Banks. It is the average rate at which money is traded daily in the Interbank market for various tenors.

question: What Does OBB And FBB Mean?
answer: OBB means Open Buy Back and FBB means Fixed Buy Back. They are both products available in the Interbank market that enables banks to access short-term funds using their Government securities as collateral. The difference between the OBB and FBB is that OBB is open-ended (i.e. like a call deposit) while FBB has a fixed tenor.

question: Where Can I Use My Zenith Bank Credit Card?
answer: You can use your Zenith Bank credit card to pay for goods and services at millions of establishments worldwide. Your card will be accepted at any establishment that displays the Visa or MasterCard logo.

question: Can I Use My Zenith Bank Credit Card To Shop On The Internet?
answer: You can use your Zenith Bank credit card to make online payments or to shop on the internet.

question: Can I Withdraw Cash Using My Zenith Bank Credit Card?
answer: You can withdraw cash up to 100% of your credit limit from any ATM.

question: Can I Use My Zenith Bank Credit Card If I Have Used My Full Credit Limit?
answer: No, you cannot use your credit card if you have used up your full credit limit until you repay. The amount repaid will then be available for your use, provided the account is not overdue.

question: Is There Any Fee For Withdrawing Cash Using My Zenith Bank Credit Card?
answer: Every time you withdraw cash from either the ATM or agent POS, a cash advance fee of 4.5% of the amount withdrawn will be charged to your card. This will be reflected in your Credit Card statement.

question: I Want To Know More About My Credit Card Statement?
answer: At the end of every cycle, we mail your monthly credit card statement to your email address as indicated on your card application form. Your statement indicates your previous balance and gives a list of your current charges, any finance charges or fees, your payments and credits as well as your current balance. It also mentions the “Minimum Payment Due” and the “Payment Due Date”.

question: How Do You Determine The Balance Mentioned In The Credit Card Statement?
answer: Your total outstanding balance is shown as “Current Balance” on your Credit Card statement. The “Current Balance” is determined by adding any purchases and cash advances you made and subtracting payments or credits from the “Previous Balance”. Then appropriate finance charges and fees are added.

question: My Credit Card Expires Next Month, What Am I Supposed To Do?
answer: The Visa expiring cards are auto renewed one month to expiration day as long as the card was in use for the past 3 months. This means at the time your card expires, your new card will be available for pick up at your branch. For Mastercard credit cards, customer is required to visit any Zenith Bank branch and make a request for credit card re-issue.

question: What is the maximum amount I can withdraw from an ATM in 24hours?
answer: You can withdraw a maximum of ₦20,000 per transaction and perform up to five transactions per day. In all, a customer can withdraw a maximum of ₦100,000 in a day. However, this may only apply to withdrawals made on Zenith Bank ATMs.

question: How Long Does It Take To Receive A Prepaid Card?
answer: Your new card will be available for pick up at your requesting branch within 48hours however we offer the non-personalized variant which can be picked up instantly at any of our branches.

question: What Should I Do When I Receive My Prepaid Card?
answer: Simply load funds on your card and it will be activated within 24hours.

question: How Do I Load Funds On My Prepaid Card?
answer: You can load your card with cash at any of our branches. Also, funds may be loaded onto the card via an online internet banking portal.

question: Can I Use My Prepaid Card After The Loaded Funds Have Been Exhausted?
answer: Your prepaid card is a reloadable card. You can add funds by reloading at any of our branches or transferring funds into it until the card expires.

question: What Is A Debit Card?
answer: The Zenith Debit Card is a payment card that represents an electronic means of withdrawing money from your bank account or making purchases with the money in your bank account. The Zenith Debit Card can be used on Zenith bank ATMs and other banks ATMs. It can also be used on POS terminals and online.

question: How Do I Get A Debit Card?
answer: Visit any Zenith Bank Branch and request your preferred card type. The Customer Service Unit (CSU) officers will provide you with an Application Form to complete and submit back to them. You also have the option of visiting our website: www.zenithbank.com and printing the Application and Service Agreement Forms. Completed forms should be returned to the Customer Service Unit at any Zenith Bank branch, and an instant card would be issued to you immediately. If you require an embossed card, your card will be ready in 2-3 working days.

question: What Is The Maximum Amount I Can Withdraw?
answer: You can withdraw a maximum of ₦20,000 per transaction and perform up to five transactions per day. In all, a customer can withdraw a maximum of ₦100,000 in a day. However, this may only apply to withdrawals made on Zenith Bank ATMs

question: When I Insert My Debit Card In The ATM It Displays The Message “Card Cannot Be Read”
answer: This means that the chip on the card chip may have been corrupted. Return the card to the Customer Service Unit (CSU) of your branch with a letter stating the issue and requesting another card. A new one will be processed for you.

question: What If The ATM Rejects My Card?
answer: Submit a letter of complaint to the CSU officers of your branch with a bad/faulty card attached.

question: If The ATM Displays The Message “Incorrect PIN”?
answer: Submit a letter of complaint (memo for staff) to the CSU officers of your branch. The letter must include account number and/or PAN.

question: My Card Got Stuck In The ATM Machine?
answer: If your card got stuck in Zenith Bank ATM, report the incident to the branch CSU officer and provide a proof of identification for validation. This happens when the PIN is entered wrongly up to three times or the card was reported missing and was hot-listed. Card will be retrieved and given to you. But if your card got stuck in another bank’s ATM, kindly visit any zenith bank branch to make a report and request for a new card.

question: I Have Forgotten My Debit Card PIN
answer: Submit a request for a new PIN through the CSU officers of your branch and a new PIN will be issued to you.

question: I Have Lost My Debit Card
answer: Immediately dial the stop debit ussd string (*966*911#) on your phone and follow the prompt to place a debit freeze on your account, afterwards please visit your branch to cancel your card, unfreeze your account and request for a new card. You can also reach out to card services via email Cardservices@zenithbank.com or 09119874901 or 02012784901 to cancel your card.

question: Can I Tie Additional Accounts To My Debit Card?
answer: Yes, you can tie additional accounts to your Debit Card. For fresh requests, there is on the Application Form for the main (default) account number to be documented. There is also the space provided on the same form for the other account numbers (that the customer has, with zenith bank and would like access to).If the customer has got his access codes for a particular account and would like to add another account to the facility, he /she is required to write a letter to that effect. The letter, which must be duly signed by him, must have the following details:; Full names Account numbers (both existing and new) Branch This letter should be submitted to CSU.

question: My Debit Card Is Damaged?
answer: Go to Quicklinks on our Homepage and click on ‘Replace your Card. Fill out the form online and submit Always place your Debit Card away from electromagnetic items e.g. mobile phones.

question: My Debit Card Has The Wrong Name On It?
answer: Please return the card with a letter requesting for another Debit Card with the correct name on it, to the CSU officer of your branch. A new card will be reprinted for you.

question: What Currency Is the Debit Card Available In?
answer: NAIRA, US DOLLARS, EUROS AND POUNDS

question: My Credit Card Expires Next Month. What Am I Supposed To Do?
answer: Visa expiring cards are auto renewed one month to expiration day as long as the card was in use for the past 3 months. This means at the time your card expires, your new card will be available for pick up at your branch. For Mastercard credit cards, customer is required to visit any Zenith Bank branch and make a request for credit card re-issue.

question: What are the features of a Debit Card?
answer: 24hrs remote access to your savings/current/cash domiciliary accounts in the bank. Quick and easy means of payment; replacing cash and cheque. Can be used wherever the card brand logo is displayed, at ATMs, POS, Web and Mail/Telephone Order. Single currency functionality for MasterCard Visa and Verve cards. No interest charges; no collateral required, no settlement required as cardholder spends only funds available in his/her account. 3D Online Security -One time password (OTP) is sent to customers mobile phone and email address to secure online transactions. Online access to transaction history through Internet Banking.

question: What Is The Validity Of The Card?
answer: MasterCard - 4 years VISA - 4 years AfriGO - 4 years Verve - 3 years

question: Can I Use My foreign currency Debit Card On Other Banks’ ATMs Within And Outside The Country?
answer: Yes, on any ATM where the MasterCard/Visa/Verve acceptance logo is displayed.

question: Can I Use The Card To Pay For Goods at stores?
answer: Yes, at POS terminals and on the Web

question: Can I Make Online Purchases With My Card?
answer: Yes, always ensure it is a 3D secure site.

question: Can I View My Transactions Online?
answer: Yes, by using your internet banking or Mobile App.

question: What is a Credit Card?
answer: A Credit Card is a form of credit issued to customers and linked to a revolving credit account. Cardholders make repayment at the end of the cycle. Credit card cycle runs from 16th of the month to 15th of the next month. Credit cards let you borrow money to buy things now and pay later.

question: What are the available credit card product types?
answer: A.Visa Credit Card B. MasterCard Credit Card

question: Who is the Credit Card for?
answer: Customers who enjoy a good relationship with the bank. Customers who want an easy to use widely-accepted way of making payments. Customers who want extra benefits such as insurance and emergency assistance. Customers who are frequent travellers.

question: What classes of Visa/MasterCard Credit Cards are available?
answer: Classic, Gold, Platinum and Visa Infinite

question: Can I have more than one Credit Card? i.e. Visa and MasterCard
answer: Yes, you can have both, MasterCard and Visa.

question: Can I migrate from one credit class to another e.g. from Classic to Gold?
answer: Yes. This will be determined by your credit history.

question: Where can I use my Visa/MasterCard?
answer: Zenith Visa/MasterCard credit card can be used wherever the Visa/MasterCard logo is displayed

question: Do I have to be a customer of the bank to get a Visa/MasterCard Credit Card from Zenith Bank?
answer: Credit cards are targeted mainly at existing customers.

question: Are there any transaction limits on the Card?
answer: Yes. Each card has its defined limits and usage parameters which is basically a fraud control measure. Parameters are set limits to the frequency and amounts for which a card can be used on a daily and monthly basis.

question: How much do I have to settle on my credit card at the end of the cycle?
answer: This is the percentage you have selected to pay back of your total outstanding usually 5%, 10%, 20%, 30%, 50% or 100%

question: What should I do if my Card is lost or damaged?
answer: Immediately inform our Card Centre on telephone numbers 09119874901 or 02012784901 or send an email to Cardservices@zenithbank.com to deactivate or hot list your card, and walk into any of our branches to pick up a new card.

question: What is a PIN?
answer: A PIN (Personal Identification Number) is a four digit number used to access card account.

question: What if my PIN is compromised?
answer: If you suspect someone else knows your PIN you must contact the bank immediately to have a new PIN issued or change it at the ATM.

question: What happens when I enter a wrong PIN?
answer: After three (3) wrong PIN tries, your card will be deactivated. You should contact your bank to obtain further instruction on how to continue using your card.

question: How do I settle my credit card transactions?
answer: You can settle your card account in two ways: A. Minimum Due Balance payment: This is settlement due from the cardholder based on the monthly statement issued. It is derived using your settlement method, which was selected on your application form. Based on the Direct Debit Mandate, this amount is automatically taken from your account during the settlement period.; b. Additional settlement: Where the cardholder personally decides to pay off all or part of the outstanding debt. In this case, the cardholder will initiate settlement on the Mobile App on Internet banking of visit the nearest branch.; Settlement period for minimum due is from 30th of every month

question: What is a Supplementary card?
answer: A Supplementary card is issued where a cardholder wishes to share the card credit limit with another; for example a spouse, child relationship, sibling etc.

question: What are the features of the Supplementary card?
answer: The features include: • A principal card must exist • Both cards will share the principal’s card limit • The principal cardholder is responsible for settlement of all transactions on the supplementary card.

question: How do I request for a new card PIN?
answer: You will obtain, complete and submit the pin-reissue form at your branch or if you remember your old PIN you can change PIN at the ATM.

question: What are the loading limits on prepaid card
answer: The cummulative loading limit for prepaid cards are: Naira prepaid card = N250,000 Dollar prepaid card = $5,000 quarterly Pound prepaid card = £3,000 quarterly Euro prepaid card = €4,000 quarterly

answer: This service is currently unavailable but you can walk into the closest zenith bank branch to you and pick up an instant payment card.

question: What card can i use for international transactions?
answer: The Zenith Bank Foreign currency cards are suitable for international transactions.

question: Why is my card not working abroad
answer: Kindly advise card services via Cardservices@zenithbank.com on your destination or current location and length of stay to allow them enable your foreign denominated card for international spend.

question: Can my naira card work on amazon website or foreign websites?
answer: This service is currently unavailable on the zenith bank naira denominated cards, however you can opt for zenith bank foreign denominated cards. These cards are suitable for international transactions.

question: How do i get a gift card?

question: How do i get a co-branded card?
answer: Prepare a request letter on your company letterhead paper specifying the number of cards required and submit the request letter to the Customer Service Unit (CSU).

question: How much does a co-branded card cost?
answer: Due to market realities, the price of the zenith bank co-branded card is dynamic, please reach out to the card services team via Cardservices@zenithbank.com to get the requirements or contact your account officer for more information on co-branded cards.

question: How much does a debit card cost?

question: What card types are offered in the Bank?
answer: The Bank offers debit, credit and prepaid card types.

question: Am I required to have an account with the bank before requesting for a prepaid card.
answer: The Zenith Bank Prepaid card is avaialble to both customers and non customers of the bank.

question: What is the difference between a gift card and a prepaid card?

question: How can the Prepaid card be loaded?

question: What reward programs does Zenith Bank cards offer?
answer: Customers tends to enjoy all benefits associated with the scheme. Futhermore, Zenith Bank premium cardholders enjoys free domestic/ int'l airport lounge access.

question: Are there any travel insurance benefits associated with Zenith bank cards?
answer: Zenith Bank premium cardholders have access to travel insurance benefits

question: What is the interest rate on a credit card?

question: How long does it take to get a credit card approved?
answer: Once the customer has met all the credit requirements, the card will be processed and made available within 5 working days.

question: What are the requirements for a credit card?
answer: To qualify for a credit card, you must have an active account with the bank. Eligibility is based on your creditworthiness or the provision of acceptable collateral, as required by the bank.

question: How does one become eligible to get a credit card?

question: What are the types of debit cards that are currently offered/available from Zenith Bank?
answer: Our Debit Cards are available in Visa, MasterCard, AFRIGO and Verve card brands

question: What do I do if I have any issues on my card account?
answer: You should promptly contact your branch or the Card Services via email Cardservices@zenithbank.com or 09119874901 or 02012784901.

question: Where can i use a virtual card?
answer: Virtual cards are developed mainly for online/ web transactions.

question: What is a virtual card?

question: How much does a Virtual card cost?
answer: The zenith bank Virtual card cost N500

question: How can i get a virtual card?

question: Can I temporarily deactivate my card?

question: Can I get multiple cards on my savings/current account?
answer: Yes, you can request multiple cards as long as they are different card brands. Available options include Visa, Mastercard, Verve, and AfriGO.

question: How can I activate my virtual card?
answer: You can activate your virtual card through the same channel used for the request—e.g., via USSD (*966#), Internet Banking, or the Zenith Bank website www.zenithbank.com

question: How can I activate my new card?

question: How can the transaction limit on my card be increased?

question: Can I get a Dollar virtual card?

question: How Can I Request A POS Terminal?
answer: You can request a POS terminal through your relationship officer.

question: How Long Does It Take To Deploy Terminal(S) To Merchants?

question: How Can I Identify The Type Of Terminal That Is Deployed To Me As A Merchant?
answer: The terminal type and model are boldly written on the face top of the Terminal e.g PAX S90 CDMA, Verifone VX 520 etc.

question: Can My POS Terminals Run On My Local Area Network?
answer: Yes, but the merchant must provide the necessary parameters required for setup.

question: What Do I Do If I Am Getting The Error Message “ISSUER OR SWITCH INOPERATIVE”?
answer: This may occur if the network of the bank that issued the card fails to connect or the switch that processes the card is having system downtime. You may ask the customer to use another bank”s card if available or try again later.

question: What If The Cardholder's Account Is Debited Without Approved Receipt Printed On The POS Terminal?
answer: Do not release goods or offer services for such transaction; there may be an automatic reversal of such transaction. Furthermore, the cardholder should visit his bank to lodge the complaint and ask for the Dispense Error Form.

question: I Have Internet In My Office And I Want To See My POS Transactions As They Occur, Is This Possible?

question: How Do I Reconcile The Bulk Settlement Made Into My Account For POS Transactions?
answer: Request the POS Settlement Viewer through your Relationship Manager by supplying the following information; 1. Your desired Username 2. Email address 3. Account Number; Upon creation you will be advised with the login credentials to access the portal and view the breakdown of all transactions done on your POS terminal. The setup is instant.

question: When Do I Get Settled For Transactions Done On My POS?
answer: Settlement is T+1 i.e. (transaction + 1 day) within 24hours.

question: Transactions Consummated On Friday Have Not Been Settled As At Monday Morning. How Can The Transactions Be Traced?
answer: Transactions are usually settled on bank working days. Transactions done on Friday would be settled before close of business on Monday.

question: What If My Transactions Are Not Settled As At When Due, Who Should I Call/Write For Help?
answer: Contact Zenith Direct via zenithdirect@zenithbank.com or call Zenith Direct on 0201-292 7000.

question: What If I Get The Error Message “Terminal Can Not Process Visa Card”?
answer: Please send a mail with Merchant name and Account number to zenithdirect@zenithbank.com for resolution.

question: What is a wallet?
answer: A wallet is an electronic product that makes use of mobile phone number as the wallet ID. It can hold monetary value and be used for day to day transactions. In the financial world, your wallet ID can be your phone number, email address etc.

question: What is Zenith Bank’s wallet called?
answer: Zenith bank’s wallet is called eaZymoney . Note: - *Your phone number is your account number*; eaZymoney is Zenith Bank’s mobile wallet solution, with which customers can send and receive money as well as perform other financial transactions with ease using a mobile phone.

question: Who can own a wallet?
answer: Anyone with a mobile phone can own a wallet and anyone can subscribe by dialing the string (*966*0# or *966*77#).; This also means that a non-Zenith Bank account holder can own a Zenith Bank wallet.

question: What details do I need to create a wallet?
answer: You will need details such as:; Last name; First name; Date of Birth

question: How do I get started?
answer: S imply dial *966*0# or *966*77# to create wallet and follow the prompt.; Step 1: Enter Last name, First name and Date of Birth (DOB).; Step 2: Receive SMS on the phone number from where the USSD string is dialed.; Step 3: “Successful wallet registration” and to dial back USSD string (i.e. *966*77*OTP#) for wallet activation

question: How do I activate my wallet?
answer: To activate your wallet, dial back the USSD string (i.e. *966*77*OTP#) received after creating your wallet.; The One-Time-Password (OTP) will be included in the SMS received.; Or; D ial *966*77# and select option 7 “Activate Wallet” to receive the SMS with USSD string (i.e. *966*77*OTP#) and your One-Time-Password (OTP).

question: How do I link my wallet to my account?
answer: After creating your wallet, Dial *966*77# on your mobile phone and select option 6 “Link Wallet to Account” .

question: Is my wallet safe?

question: What is wallet PIN?

question: What is USSD PIN?
answer: A USSD PIN is a 4-Digit PIN that the new wallet owner will be prompted to input during the wallet creation. Note: A user can either use wallet PIN or USSD PIN (for customers already registered on USSD only).

question: How do I change or reset my Wallet or USSD PIN?
answer: To change your USSD PIN, D ial *966*60# and select option 3 “Reset PIN” .

question: Do I need to have an account with the bank to own a wallet?

question: What Is GlobalPAY?
answer: GlobalPAY is a web-based solution that enables corporate bodies with or without functional websites accept card payments from customers worldwide.

question: Who Is GlobalPAY Suited For?
answer: Any Corporate organization, business segment that offers goods or services.

question: What Type Of Card Is Acceptable On GlobalPAY Payment Gateway?
answer: MasterCard (local & International), Visa (local & international), Interswitch Verve cards.

question: What Are The Pre-Requisites For Merchants To Have Access To The GlobalPAY Payment Gateway Platform?
answer: A corporate account domiciled in any of the Zenith Bank branches in Nigeria.; A duly completed GlobalPAY Merchant Application & Agreement Form.; A copy of the company’s Certificate of Incorporation.

question: What Happens After Submitting The GlobalPAY Merchant Application Forms?
answer: Our GlobalPAY Support/Technical team will contact the merchant and merchant’s developer by providing the relevant Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) required for the integration (this is expected to be carried out on a demo environment), and after integration is fully completed, the merchant would be migrated to Live/Production environment.

question: My Organization/Firm Does Not Have A Functional Website, How Can We Also Enjoy The GlobalPAY Payment Gateway Service?
answer: We have a GlobalPAY Storefront (www.GlobalPAY.com.ng) where your services can be hosted and all your customers can be directed to make payment to your organisation/firm through the channel.

question: Is There Any Setup Fee For The GlobalPAY Integration?
answer: No. There is no setup fee.

question: What Are The Features/Benefits Of GlobalPAY?
answer: Features/Benefits of GlobalPAY includes:; Acceptance of locally and internationally issued cards: MasterCard, Visa and Verve Cards.; Online real-time log for monitoring transactions as they occur.; Real-time online processing of transactions i.e. instant debit of cardholder’s account immediately payment is made.; Multiple card acceptances with single integration. Provides a global reach for your business.; Reduces administrative overhead.; Multi-currency processing; Refund Capability/Automated Refund Processing; Fully Redundant Processing; PCI Compliance ensures highest levels of data protection; Online Authorization Voiding; Supports Mastercard Securecode and Verified By Visa; Settlement can be done both in Naira and Dollars; Provides a global reach for your business

question: What Is The Transaction Fee For GlobalPAY Transactions?
answer: Transaction fee for MasterCard & Visa (Local) is 1.5% of the transaction amount capped at ₦2,000.00, Interswitch Verve is also 1.5% capped at ₦2,000.00 while MasterCard and Visa (international) charge 3.5% of the transaction amount without cap.

question: What Is The Transaction Settlement Cycle For My GlobalPAY Transactions?
answer: Where there is no systemic failure, all local transactions are settled into merchant’s account one working day after transaction date and two working days after transaction date for foreign transactions. However, whenever there is a systemic failure, merchants are promptly advised of their settlement delay through their account/relationship officers.

question: Who Bears The Transaction Fee – A Cardholder Or The Merchant?
answer: Transaction fee is charged per payment and is automatically charged to the merchant.

question: How Secure Are GlobalPAY Transactions?
answer: All payment transactions through Zenith Bank’s payment platform utilize 128-bit SSL technology. This guarantees that all information transmitted through these sites are encrypted and highly secure.

question: What Is 3D Secure?
answer: 3D Secure allows cardholders authenticate themselves while making online payments. It allows 3 domains to work seamlessly together. Domain 1: The cardholders have the peace of mind that their cards are not used without their authorization. Domain 2: Merchants are protected from fraud and can provide the product and service without delay or extra costs. Domain 3: Banks see that the transaction has been authenticated and are more likely to approve the transaction, to the convenience of the cardholders. The implementation of 3D Secure by Visa is called Verified by Visa, and the implementation of 3D Secure by MasterCard is called Secure Code.

question: What Is MasterCard® SecureCode™?
answer: MasterCard SecureCode is a service to enhance your existing MasterCard account. A private code means added protection against unauthorized use of your card when you shop at participating online retailers.

question: When Do I Need MasterCard SecureCode?
answer: Every time you pay online with your MasterCard, a box pops up from your card issuer asking you for your personal SecureCode, just like the bank does at the ATM. In seconds, your card issuer confirms it’s you and allows your purchase to be completed.

question: How Does MasterCard SecureCode Work?
answer: Once you’ve registered and created your own private SecureCode, you will be automatically prompted by your financial institution at checkout to provide your SecureCode each time you make a purchase with a participating online merchant. Your SecureCode is quickly confirmed by your financial institution and then your purchase is completed. Your SecureCode will never be shared with the merchant. It’s just like entering your PIN at an ATM.

question: How Does MasterCard SecureCode Protect Me?
answer: When you correctly enter your SecureCode during a purchase at a participating online merchant, you confirm that you are the authorized cardholder and your purchase is then completed. If an incorrect SecureCode is entered, the purchase will not be completed. Even if someone knows your credit or debit card number, the purchase cannot be completed without your SecureCode at a participating merchant.

question: What Card Do I Use? Will I Need To Get A New Card To Use MasterCard SecureCode?
answer: You will be able to use any of your existing MasterCard credit or debit cards, as long as the cards are from a participating financial institution. If you’re not sure if your financial institution provides this service, please contact your bank.

question: How Many Cards Can I Register With MasterCard SecureCode?
answer: We encourage you to register all of your MasterCard cards. There is no limit on how many cards you can register.

question: Can Two People With A Joint Account Use The Same Password Or Should They Register MasterCard SecureCode Separately?
answer: Enrollment is at the account level so the password must be shared.

question: Can I Use MasterCard SecureCode From Any Computer?
answer: Because there’s no special software to install, you can shop from any computer and still receive the added protection afforded by MasterCard SecureCode.

question: What Happens When My Card Expires Or My Billing Information Changes?
answer: Your card issuer will automatically update this information in your profile.

question: What Happens If I Cancel My Existing Card Then Get A New One With A Different Account Number?
answer: You will need to register the new card for MasterCard SecureCode. Simply return to the registration site, and complete the registration process with your new card.

question: How Do I Know Whether A Merchant Participates In SecureCode?
answer: Most participating merchants will display the MasterCard SecureCode logo on their site. However, even if you don’t see the SecureCode logo, the merchant may still be a participant and you will be prompted to provide your SecureCode.

question: How Will The Online Merchant Know That I’m Registered For MasterCard SecureCode?
answer: When you use a card that is enrolled in the MasterCard SecureCode program at participating online merchants, the merchant automatically recognizes your MasterCard card number during the transaction.

question: What Happens When I Use My SecureCode At A Participating Merchant?
answer: There is no need to login or sign in. When you make a purchase at a participating merchant and enter your registered MasterCard payment details, you will automatically be prompted by your financial institution to enter your SecureCode. After reviewing the details of your purchase and confirming that your Personal Greeting is correct, simply type in your SecureCode to complete your purchase.

question: What Is A SecureCode Personal Greeting?
answer: The Personal Greeting is a message that you create during sign-up. Each time you make an online purchase at a participating merchant, you will be prompted to enter your SecureCode. At this time, you’ll see your Personal Greeting and other purchase details. The Personal Greeting is your assurance that you are communicating with your financial institution. If the Personal Greeting displayed in the pop-up box is incorrect, you should not enter your SecureCode, but should instead contact Customer Service immediately by calling the phone number on the back of your enrolled MasterCard card, to report a possible fraud.

question: What Are The Secret Question And Answer?
answer: If you forget your SecureCode when making an online purchase, you will be supplied with your Secret Question. If you then supply the correct Answer, your purchase will be completed. Once your purchase is completed, you should visit the registration site, click on the “Forgot SecureCode” link and follow the subsequent instructions.

question: How Will SecureCode Change The Online Purchase Process?
answer: The online purchase process will not change except that now you will be prompted to provide your SecureCode during checkout. Your SecureCode will never be revealed to the merchant during the checkout process.

question: Will I Be Able To Make Purchases At Merchants That Accept MasterCard But Do Not Participate In The MasterCard SecureCode Program?
answer: Yes, you will not be asked for your SecureCode during these purchases. You will continue to be protected from unauthorized purchases by Zero Liability from MasterCard.

question: I Am A Merchant Who Would Like To Offer SecureCode To My Customers. How Do I Get More Information?
answer: For information on participating in MasterCard SecureCode, please contact GlobalPAY Support team via email at GlobalPAYsupport@zenithbank.com or send a mail to zenithdirect@zenithbank.com

question: Why Should I Sign Up For Verified By Visa?
answer: Visa offers comprehensive fraud protection, but Verified by Visa goes even a step further, adding an extra layer of security at the point where you enter credit card information online. The service helps prevent unauthorized online use before it happens.

question: Doesn’t Visa Already Protect My Card From Theft And Fraud?
answer: Visa’s multiple layers of protection give you an extraordinary level of security, so you can feel confident whenever and wherever you use your card. Verified by Visa is only one part of our five-layer system to prevent, detect, and resolve security issues. Specifically designed to make online shopping experiences safer and more secure, Verified by Visa gives you extra control over your Internet transactions.

question: Can I Use Verified By Visa With Any Visa Card I Have Now?
answer: Yes, Verified by Visa is designed to protect the Visa card, or cards, that you already have – whether they are credit cards or debit cards.

question: How Do I Shop With Verified By Visa?
answer: When you pay with your Visa card, the Verified by Visa service launches automatically at participating online stores. After you enter your Visa card number and submit your order, a Verified by Visa window will appear and your card issuer will display an authentication page.

question: What Is AlertZ?
answer: AlertZ is Zenith Bank transaction notification product that sends details of consummated transactions to customers via SMS and email.

question: How Does AlertZ Work?
answer: The notifications are delivered via email or mobile SMS technologies.

question: Who Needs AlertZ And For What?

AlertZ gives you updated information on the following:; all withdrawals from accounts; all ATM withdrawals; all pos purchases; all internet banking transfers – to and from accounts; these could span through salary earners, traders, transporters with the need for shipping documents, BC notification – bills for collection, LC notification – letter of credit, form m notification (approval & scanning stage), RAR notification (risk assessment report) transaction notification – deposit & full (deposits & withdrawals), monthly statements notifications.

question: How Do I Subscribe To AlertZ?

question: What Is The Reference Number That Comes With The SMS?
answer: This is a reference number which confirms if an AlertZ is genuine or not. You can further confirm the reference number by doing the following;; Send ‘verify *reference number’ to 30010 for Airtel, MTN, Visafone and 9mobile subscribers; Or 31010 for Globacom subscribers.

question: What Are The Charges Associated With Using AlertZ?
answer: Email notifications are free. For SMS notifications, the charge is ₦4 per notification.

question: Is It Possible To Subscribe To Only Email Or SMS?
answer: It is possible and allowed.

question: I Do Not Want To Use AlertZ Anymore, What Do I Do?
answer: Write a letter requesting the deactivation of the service. This may be processed at any of the Branches.

question: Can AlertZ Be Set Up Using My Foreign Mobile Number?
answer: Yes. It can be set up for your foreign mobile number.

question: What is Zenith Mobile banking?
answer: This is a service that allows you to manage your bank account and perform transactions using your smartphone.

question: Who can use the Zenith Mobile App?
answer: All Zenith Bank customers with smartphones, Android or iOS, can access the Zenith Mobile App.

question: What is the set-up cost for the Zenith Mobile App?
answer: Downloading the Zenith Mobile App is totally free.

question: What can I do on the Zenith Mobile App?
answer: The Zenith Mobile App enables you to conduct inter-bank transfers and transfers to other banks. Additionally, you can use the app to pay bills like electricity, DStv, betting schedule bill payments, view your bank statement and so much more.

question: What are the transaction fees for the Zenith Mobile App?
answer: For transactions between N0 - N5000 fees are N10.75, N5,0001 - N50,000 fees are N26.88 N50,001 and above the fees are N53.75 For Bill Payments - #100

question: Can I use my Zenith Mobile App outside the country?
answer: Yes, you can!

question: I have multiple accounts with Zenith Bank. Can I see these on the Zenith Mobile App?
answer: Yes, It is possible to see all your Zenith Bank accounts on the App. Visit the Nearest Zenith Bank Branch to get started.

question: How do I sign up as a first-time user on the Zenith Mobile App?
answer: Go to your Play Store or App store to download the Zenith Mobile App. After you download, launch the app and register.

question: What are the different registration methods on the Zenith Mobile App?
answer: Registration for the Zenith Mobile App can be done through the use of your Zenith bank Hardware/etoken, Bank card (Debit Card) and Branch Registration.

question: Can I enable Biometrics with Face ID or Fingerprints?
answer: Yes. You can enable at the point of login.

question: Can I disable Biometrics on the Zenith Mobile App?
answer: Log into the zenith bank mobile app Tap settings located at the overview section Select Biometrics to enable or disable

question: On how many devices can I use the Zenith Mobile App?
answer: A customer can have the Zenith Mobile App on 3 devices. However after the first device subsequent addition of device will require hardware/etoken to authorize.

question: What is the transfer limit on the Zenith Mobile App?
answer: Debit Card - N200,000 Branch Registration + OTP - N2,000,000 Hardware/etoken Registration - N5,0000,00-N25,000,000

question: How do I increase my Limit on the Zenith Mobile App?
answer: Tap on 'Settings' in the menu, Select 'Transfer Limits' Read and accept the terms and conditions for limit increase. Choose the account for the limit increase Click on either 'Zenith Transfer' (For Transfers to Zenith) or 'Third-Party Transfer'. for Other Banks Click 'Confirm' Authorize using Hardware or etoken

question: What is Transaction Pin?
answer: Transaction Pin is a four digit code created at the point of registration. It is used to complete transactions.

question: How do I RESET my Transaction Pin?
answer: To reset your 4-digit PIN, Access the menu and click on "Settings. Then, select "Reset PIN." Choose your authorization mode, enter a new PIN, confirm the new PIN, and input either your card or token details. Finally, click "Confirm"

question: What is a valid Password?
answer: Password is a six digit code created at the point of registration and to Login in to the Zenith Mobile App

question: How do I RESET my Password?
answer: To change your Zenith Mobile App password, go to the menu, select 'Settings', then click on 'Change Password.' Enter your old password, set a new password, and confirm the new password. To change your Zenith Mobile App password, go to the menu, select 'Settings,' then click on 'Change Password.'

question: What is a Bank Statement?
answer: A bank statement is an official summary of financial transactions at a given period of time for each bank account held by a person or business with Zenith Bank.

question: Where can I send my Bank statement to?
answer: You can send your Bank statement to your personal Email address, Financial Institution, and Embassy

question: How can I Generate Bank a statement?
answer: For Embassy and Financial Institution From the menu, click on 'Bank Services,' then select 'My Bank Statement. Choose the account from which you want to generate the statement, select the account for the transaction fee, pick a destination from the drop-down menu, select a start date and end date, and then click on 'Validate.

question: My Bank statement sent to the embassy or financial institution did not generate a code
answer: Visit the Nearest Zenith Bank or send a mail to Zenith Direct with details of transaction.

question: How to Add a Beneficiary
answer: To initiate a transfer, click on "Transfer." Choose the bank you wish to transfer to and select the account from which you want to transfer funds. Enter the beneficiary's account details, input the amount, and provide a transaction description. Activate the "Save as Beneficiary" toggle to save the beneficiary for future transactions. Finally, enter your PIN to confirm the transfer.

question: How do I manage my beneficiary list?
answer: Navigate to the menu and click on "Settings." Then, select "Manage Beneficiaries." Choose either "Transfers" or "Payments," and your list of beneficiaries will appear.

question: How to delete a beneficiary?
answer: Navigate to the menu and click on "Settings." Then, select "Manage Beneficiaries." Choose either "Transfers" or "Payments," and your list of beneficiaries will appear. Click on the bin icon next to the name of the beneficiary to delete a beneficiary, and authenticate by entering your PIN.

question: How to save a beneficiary after a transfer is done?
answer: Initiate a transfer, click on "Transfer." Choose the bank you wish to transfer to and select the account from which you want to transfer funds. Enter the beneficiary's account details, input the amount, and provide a transaction description. Activate the "Save as Beneficiary" toggle to save the beneficiary for future transactions. Finally, enter your PIN to confirm the transfer.

question: Can I pay bills on the Zenith Mobile App?
answer: Yes. Click on "Bills," then choose either Zenith Billers or Quick teller Merchants. Select an account, followed by a category, and then pick a specific biller. Input the requested details, and click "Continue." Confirm the details of the bill payment, and authorize by entering your PIN.

question: What Bills Can I Pay?
answer: Electricity, DSTV, GOTV, Airtime, Internet and so much more

question: How do I report a bill payment problem?
answer: To log a failed bill payment, visit the nearest Zenith Branch or send an email to ZenithDirect.

question: How do I generate a receipt after a transfer?
answer: Go to Transfers Tab and select Transfer History to generate a receipt.

question: Can I send USD/Pounds with my USD account to a foreign account?
answer: No.

question: Can I send USD with my USD account to a Local Domiciliary Account?
answer: No.

question: What if a transfer fails and my account was debited?
answer: Visit the nearest Zenith Bank Branch or send a mail to ZenithDirect

question: I bought Airtime, but didn't get value
answer: Visit the nearest Zenith Bank Branch or send a mail to Zenith Direct.

question: I recharged a large sum of airtime. Is there a way to reverse this?
answer: Visit the nearest Zenith Bank Branch or send a mail to Zenith Direct.

question: (FOR CUSTOMERS) What is Scan to Pay?
answer: Scan to pay is an application that allows you make fast, simple and secure payments by scanning QR codes at merchants’ outlets using your smart phone. OR You can also dial the Merchant ID displayed at the merchant’s outlet using any GSM phone and enter a 4-digit pin to complete transaction.

question: What is a QR Code?
answer: QR is an acronym for Quick Response code. It is similar to the barcode displayed on items or goods in stores.

question: Who is the Scan to Pay app for?
answer: The Scan to pay app is designed for all bank’s customers.

question: Can I add another account phone number?

question: Which account number will be debited?

question: How will I know if a transaction is successful?
answer: You will receive an email notification and an SMS notification on your registered phone number with the bank. The app will show an on-screen notification.

question: Is there a transaction limit?
